model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) of several algorithms as a function of co-occurrence number. The x-axis, labeled “Co-occurrence Number,” represents a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e1 to 1e10, with tick marks spaced by increments of 10, and the values are marked in base-10 notation. The y-axis, labeled “ACC (%)”, is a linear scale spanning from 30 to 68, with tick marks incremented by 5. Five lines are plotted, each representing a different algorithm: a black line with circular markers (Base), a purple line with diamond markers (MEND), a cyan line with triangular markers (FT), a blue line with square markers (MEMIT), and a red line with diamond markers (IKE), and a green line with diamond markers (ROME). At the beginning of the x-axis, the Base line is at approximately 40%, the MEND line is at approximately 43%, the FT line is at approximately 43%, the MEMIT line is at approximately 42%, and the IKE line is at approximately 40%. The ROME line rises to approximately 64% at the end of the x-axis, while the other lines remain relatively constant around 58-61%.
